user: I want to dispute TX-0601 on account ACC-1007, EUR 310 FurnitureLoft, because the goods did not arrive. If you cannot do this, please refer it to a human and tell me the next step.
answer:
I could not open the dispute for TX-0601, so I have referred your case to a human support agent.

**What happened**
- The eligibility check for a "goods not received" dispute on TX-0601 returned not eligible. The reason code, transaction status, and 90-day window checks passed, but a customer-level restriction on your account requires escalation. I can't open the dispute while that is in place, and I can't share further detail on the restriction.
- I have not opened a dispute and no changes were made to your account.

**Next step**
- Your case is queued with escalation ID 1 under customer CUS-0006 (Farid Aliyev). A human agent will review it and contact you.
- The dispute window for TX-0601 runs until 2026-11-14, so there is time for the review. Keep any communication with FurnitureLoft about the non-delivery (order confirmations, tracking details, messages) to support your claim.
